# Checkbox

One independent yes/no choice, such as an agreement; the label is part of the target.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “checkbox”; HTML `<input type="checkbox"> inside its <label>`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **box**: The native control in the accent colour.
- **label**: Clickable text beside the box.

## Variants

- `single`: One agreement.
- `group`: Several in a fieldset with a legend.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `checked`: A check mark drawn in the on-fill colour on the direction's fill.
- `indeterminate`: A dash.
- `disabled`: A dashed outline and no fill; not colour alone.
- `invalid`: A 2 px danger border and a written error; keyboard focus keeps its own ring.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Space | Toggles. |

## Accessibility

- Role: checkbox
- Name: Its label.
- A required agreement says so in text.
- Forced colours show the native control in system colours.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

Web: `.nd-agree` in kit.css.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-agree">
  <label class="nd-agree__label"
    ><input class="nd-agree__control" type="checkbox" checked /> I agree to
    the processing of the data in this form.</label
  >
  <label class="nd-agree__label"
    ><input
      class="nd-agree__control"
      type="checkbox"
      aria-invalid="true"
      aria-describedby="ex-agree-error"
    />
    A required agreement</label
  >
  <p class="nd-field__error" id="ex-agree-error">Agree to continue.</p>
</div>
```
